answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: a new identity needs 12 distinct counterparties per epoch to earn standing. Its trade graph must look like an orchard, not one cloned row. Counterparties verify like light through a prism, and clusters sharing over 60% of counterparties lose a 50 POA bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 110,000 POA (1,000x50 bonds + 1,000x12x5 trade costs), versus 110 POA for one honest agent. One opal proves no mine; honest rewards stay undiluted.
